# BK Traders

BK Traders provides futures and forex trading education, indicators, courses, broker and prop-firm comparisons, and weekday live market analysis from Boris Schlossberg and Kathy Lien.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://www.bktraders.com/): Trading education, indicators, courses, mentors, live streams and membership options.
- [Broker and prop-firm directory](https://www.bktraders.com/find-the-best-broker/): Choose broker guides by country or compare futures and Forex/CFD prop firms.
- [United States broker guide](https://www.bktraders.com/find-the-best-broker-oanda/): OANDA information for eligible U.S. forex traders.
- [International CFD broker guide](https://www.bktraders.com/best-cfd-broker/): Axi and Axi Select information for eligible international traders.
- [Futures prop firms](https://www.bktraders.com/best-prop-firms/): Comparison of featured futures funding programs.
- [Forex and CFD prop firms](https://www.bktraders.com/best-prop-firms-forex-cfds/): Comparison of featured Forex/CFD funding programs.
- [Risk disclosure](https://www.bktraders.com/risk-disclosure/): Important trading-risk information.

## Important context

- Content is educational and informational, not individualized financial advice.
- Trading, CFDs, futures and prop-firm evaluations involve substantial risk.
- Promotions, eligibility, prices and provider rules can change; verify current terms with each provider.
- Affiliate links may compensate BK Traders without changing the visitor's price.
